summary: Caples Lake (Eldorado NF): FS page + Eldorado ROG + rec.gov search + Esri. Operating, off season now. First-come, $36 single/$72 double, late June-September, 34 sites of which 7 take a trailer/RV (12, 23, 25, 27-30), vault toilets, water, no dump. Lakeview kept. Site count corrected 16 -> 34.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview kept. The campground loops sit north of Hwy 88; the highway, then Caples Lake Resort and the marina, lie between them and the lake (Esri 2026-11-26). No site can be lakefront. The stored evidence (open granite slope, downhill sightline to the lake ~100-150 m away) matches the imagery.
Sites count corrected 16 -> 34 (FS page and ROG). Only 7 sites (12, 23, 25, 27-30) take a trailer or RV; no length limit is posted.
Season: the stored derived 06-20 to 09-30 now rests on the FS page ('late June - September'); 06-20 is an approximation of 'late June'.

Website: replace both generic lines ('https://www.fs.usda.gov/r05/eldorado' and 'https://www.recreation.gov') with 'https://www.fs.usda.gov/r05/eldorado/recreation/caples-lake-campground'. There is no rec.gov listing; the campground is first-come.
Pin 38.70450,-120.05340 is ~70 m from the FS point (38.704164,-120.052795), inside the loops: fine.
The stored note said 'south shore of Caples Lake'; the campground is north of Hwy 88, across from the lake's north-west shore. Corrected in the rewrite.
